name: Chart
description: Plots your data with tooltips, legends, and colors that track the theme.

dependencies.name: recharts
dependencies.reason: Optional — powers Chart.Tooltip and Chart.Legend. Without it the container shows the data table, or a 'Chart unavailable' state.

config.description: ChartConfig mapping each data key to a label and a series index 1–6 (reads --fui-chart-N), with an optional legend icon

children.description: A recharts chart component (LineChart, BarChart, etc.)

summary.description: Non-visual summary announced to assistive technology users

dataTable.description: Accessible data table or textual fallback; shown visibly when recharts is missing

loading.description: Draws a skeleton at the chart's height while the data loads

empty.description: The empty state's title, shown when the chart child's data is an empty array

emptyDescription.description: The empty state's copy under the title: why there is nothing yet

emptyAction.description: The empty state's one way forward (a Button)

error.description: When set, replaces the chart with an error box (danger glyph, this message, retry)

onRetry.description: Retry the failed load; shows a retry button in the error box

when: A trend over time is the point
Categories need comparing side by side
A whole splits into parts worth seeing
whenNot: One number tells the story (use Text or Badge)
guidelines: Wrap every recharts chart in ChartContainer
Map each data key to a label and a series index; draw the series with var(--fui-chart-N)
Never colour a series with a status hue — status colours mean status
Pair with ChartTooltip and ChartLegend rather than recharts' own
Give the container a real height — recharts cannot measure zero; loading, empty and error keep that height
A failed load passes error with words that say what to do and onRetry for the way out; an empty chart passes empty, emptyDescription and one emptyAction
accessibility: The frame is role img with an aria-label; pass summary for the takeaway
ChartConfig labels are what the tooltip and legend read
Pass dataTable to offer the same numbers as text
Loading sets aria-busy; empty and error render as a labelled group with words, not colour; the error box is an alert

examples.name: Line Chart
examples.description: Two series share one scale; a dashed target line reads as a goal, not data.

examples.name: Bar Chart
examples.description: Fixed categories, compared by height — the safest default.

examples.name: Area Chart
examples.description: The fill under the line stresses volume, not just direction.

examples.name: States
examples.description: Loading, empty and error stay in the chart's own box.
examples.code:
import { type ChartConfig } from "@/components/Chart";

const config: ChartConfig = { revenue: { label: "Revenue", series: 1 } };
const data = [{ month: "Jan", revenue: 4200 }, { month: "Feb", revenue: 4800 }];

<>
  <ChartContainer config={config} loading aria-label="Revenue">
    <LineChart data={data} />
  </ChartContainer>
  <ChartContainer config={config} empty="No revenue in this range" aria-label="Revenue">
    <LineChart data={[]} />
  </ChartContainer>
  <ChartContainer config={config} error="Couldn't load revenue" aria-label="Revenue">
    <LineChart data={data} />
  </ChartContainer>
</>

relations.note: Charts are typically placed inside Cards
Combine with Table for full data views

propsSummary: config: ChartConfig - maps data keys to labels and series indexes (--fui-chart-1..6)
loading / empty / error - states drawn in the chart's own box
Chart.Tooltip / Chart.Legend support custom content renderers for advanced overlays
